use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let random = System.Random(314)

darts() -> Pipe[(x: double, y: double)] is
    while true do
        yield (x = random.next_double(), y = random.next_double())
    od
si

inside(p: (x: double, y: double)) -> bool => p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 1.0D

estimate(throws: int) -> double =>
    let hits = darts() |> take(throws) |> filter(inside) |> count() in
    4.0D * cast double(hits) / cast double(throws)

for power in 2::7 do
    let throws = cast int(Math.pow(10.0D, cast double(power)))
    let pi = estimate(throws)

    let error = Math.abs(pi - Math.pi)

    write_line("{throws,10} throws: pi is about {pi:F6}, off by {error:F6}")
od

let image = IMAGE(300, 300)

image.view(0.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D)
image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)

for p in darts() |> take(4000) do
    if inside(p) then
        image.colour(40ub, 90ub, 180ub)
    else
        image.colour(210ub, 70ub, 50ub)
    fi

    image.dot(p.x, p.y, 1.5D)
od

image.write("darts.png")

image.show("darts.png")

    od
si

inside(p: (x: double, y: double)) -> bool => p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 1.0D

estimate(throws: int) -> double =>
    let hits = darts() |> take(throws) |> filter(inside) |> count() in
    4.0D * cast double(hits) / cast double(throws)

    let pi = estimate(throws)

od
